events.headline: CDW to Acquire Lovelytics to Turn Customer Data into Business Value

lifecycle.authority: Retained structured Lifecycle authority; Markdown and SQLite not read

providers.reason: CDW reported record Q3 results, beating on both top and bottom lines with 18% revenue growth driven by enterprise AI adoption and robust infrastructure demand. Management raised full-year profit guidance and increased the quarterly dividend by 8%, ending a period of stagnant growth and triggering an analyst price target upgrade to $185.
providers.risk: Margin pressure from a high-volume hardware sales mix and rising operating expenses.

providers.reason: Q3 revenue rose 17.7% to $6.75B versus ~$6.19B consensus, non-GAAP EPS $3.26 beat $2.98, and FY outlook was raised on AI infrastructure/data-center demand. Shares jumped ~14% with Evercore to $185 Outperform and Citi to $170, supporting post-earnings drift.
providers.risk: Chasing a 14% gap: hardware-heavy mix cut gross margin 140bp, and Democratic data-center regulatory scrutiny could temper the AI infrastructure narrative.

providers.reason: Record Q3 sales $6.75B +17.7% vs $6.19B expected, EPS $3.26 vs $2.98 +20% YoY on broad hardware/software demand.
providers.risk: Sharp ~13% breakout above 52-week high invites profit-taking, especially with margin compression noted.
